failure_rule: per model and view: the first six wrong-object or ASK outcomes by SHA-256 of UTF-8(salt + LF + model + LF + request ID), ties by request ID; for reading only
interpretation: One inspected development room (ScanNet scene0010_01 through IRef-VLA), annotated geometry, parser-conditioned and category-complete subscenes: 256 parents are a broader development screen, not an unseen-room evaluation. The pilot's 32 parents are excluded and the reserved lab commands stay closed.

Correct means the chosen object is the published target. A mismatch does not by itself show a choice wrong under every reading of the adapted geometry; the rules' answerability (resolved, ambiguous, insufficient information) is reported apart from agreement with the target.
An ASK on a uniquely annotated command is not correct and earns no ambiguity credit; restricted shares are not calibrated confidence and no threshold is applied.

Each parent and view has one frozen, answer-blind letter assignment and list order; the always-B and always-second-position figures are this sample's actual reference rates, and the randomization does not remove code sensitivity.
The source-known view is an annotation-derived diagnostic condition, not a demonstrated deployment inventory.
No significance test, format winner, Gate B result or headset claim follows; both formats go to A2.4.
